Title: Public Preview: Long-term retention for CMK-enabled Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server

Body.Content:
You can now configure long-term backups for Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server data that is encrypted using customer-managed keys (CMKs). Using Azure Backup or Azure Data Services, you can retain Azure PostgreSQL - Flexible Server backups for up to 10 years. The comprehensive data protection helps safeguard against various levels of data loss, such as accidental deletions and ransomware attacks. You also have the flexibility to schedule and perform backups as needed. For added protection, backups are isolated and stored in a separate security and fault domain. Additionally, you can centrally monitor all backup operations and jobs for ease of management.

Learn more.
